name: emotion_analysis_indonlu_benchmark
description: A benchmark for emotion classification in Indonesian text, derived from the IndoNLU ecosystem. It contains labeled examples of user utterances annotated for emotion categories and is intended to evaluate models' ability to detect emotions in Indonesian-language text. Typical use is training and evaluating supervised classifiers for multi-class emotion detection.
reputation: Community dataset within the IndoNLU collection with modest adoption for Indonesian NLP emotion/sentiment tasks.
